title: Quasi-affineness characterized by affine basic opens of global functions
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For $a\in\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ put $Z_a=\{z\in Z:a_z\in\mathcal O_{Z,z}^{\times}\}$, the open locus where its germ is a unit. Then $Z$ is quasi-affine, meaning isomorphic to a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme [def-weil-open-immersion], if and only if $Z$ is quasi-compact (every open covering has a finite subcover) and for every $z\in Z$ there is $a\in\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ with $z\in Z_a$ and $Z_a$ affine. The empty scheme is allowed.
